usefulness.rationale: The dossier body is completely empty; the only content is a one-line identity anchor (Filipino-American journalist, Rappler co-founder, 2021 Nobel Peace laureate) and a single retained Wikipedia reference whose extraction coverage is "unattempted." A reader learns only the bare identity label — nothing about her actual work, the legal cases, her journalism career, or the Nobel citation. No section acknowledges what is missing, so the dossier does not flag its gaps. There is no material to prepare for a meeting beyond name recognition. No overclaims can be assessed because there are no dossier statements or citations to evaluate, even though the unjustified-conclusions list (sole-Nobel, all-reporting) warns of likely inflation in any full text.
